From curiosity
to craft.

Curiosity

The first spark. Technology caught my attention early, and I started exploring how software and networks really work.

Learning

Learning the language of machines. I studied IT and Networking, and wrote my first lines of code in C++.

Foundation

Building the base. Digital documents, databases and PL/SQL gave me the foundation to think in systems, not just screens.

Practice

Learning by building. I explored Web development and Flutter, and turned what I studied into projects of my own.

Full Stack

Going full stack. Angular, Spring and databases came together, and I started building complete systems from end to end.

Design

Designing beyond the screen. I design custom 3D boxes for factories and clients in Saudi Arabia. I've worked with 13 clients, and the designs were printed and delivered.

Now

From curiosity to craft. Today I'm training with the Full Stack team at NTG, building real products: an employee management system, an online store, a sign language translator and a sports cars showroom.
